text: This report recommends the enactment of the Financial By-law 2-18 and Borrowing and Investing of Money By-law 3-18 and that the by-laws be submitted to City Council for approval.

City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the Financial By-law and the Borrowing and Investing of Money By-law in Appendices A and B to the report (February 4, 2019) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place.
